parameters.content:
Production-style lead pipeline:
Landing form -> duplicate check -> Google Sheets CRM -> Telegram admin alert -> client/admin reminder.

Set env vars in n8n:
GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID
GOOGLE_SHEETS_SHEET_NAME
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
ADMIN_CHAT_ID
N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, duplicate: true, leadId: $json.leadId, message: 'Duplicate lead' }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const lead = $json;

return [{
  json: {
    'Дата заявки': lead.createdAt,
    'Имя клиента': lead.clientName,
    'Телефон': lead.phone,
    'Услуга': lead.serviceTitle,
    'Цена': lead.price,
    'Мастер': lead.master,
    'Дата визита': lead.visitDate,
    'Время визита': lead.visitTime,
    'Статус': lead.status,
    'Источник': lead.source,
    'Telegram chat ID': lead.telegramChatId,
    leadId: lead.leadId,
    clientName: lead.clientName,
    phone: lead.phone,
    serviceTitle: lead.serviceTitle,
    visitDate: lead.visitDate,
    visitTime: lead.visitTime,
    telegramChatId: lead.telegramChatId
  }
}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, duplicate: false, leadId: $items('Prepare CRM Row')[0].json.leadId, crm: 'google_sheets', pipeline: 'n8n' }) }}
